3 Bedroom House in Tokai

2 the nest, 16 weaver bird avenue
3 3.5 1 365 m² 365 m²

The Nest | Boutique Residential Estate in Tokai

Introducing The Nest, a private collection of just six contemporary three-bedroom residences set along Weaver Bird Avenue in the established neighbourhood of Tokai.

Designed around the rhythm of everyday life, each home combines generous open-plan living with bespoke kitchens, concealed sculleries, private landscaped gardens and expansive indoor-outdoor entertainment spaces. Optional swimming pools, built-in braais, fireplaces, work-from-home spaces and double garages add considered touches to each residence.

Beyond the homes, The Nest offers a boutique estate environment with monitored access, a carefully considered arrival experience and a sense of privacy and calm. Its Tokai setting places residents close to Tokai Forest, Constantia, leading schools, cafes and everyday conveniences, while retaining the quieter character of one of Cape Town''s most established family neighbourhoods.

Priced from R10.50 million VAT inclusive, with no transfer duty and a 10 deposit required. Private offers are available until 27 August 2026 at 12pm, ahead of the public sales launch on 3 September 2026 at 12pm. Anticipated completion is Q1 2028.

The Nest offers a rare opportunity to secure a newly built home in one of Cape Town''s most tightly held neighbourhoods.
